_comment: AGENT-EDITABLE self-pacing. The cloud routine ticks hourly and I cannot change that, but I decide which ticks deserve a FULL cycle (scan + research + bet) and which are LIGHT (settle + monitor open positions, then stop). Set next_full_cycle_after when a full cycle would be wasted — e.g. no candidate resolves for hours, or research sources are unavailable. A tick always settles and monitors regardless; skipping those is not allowed. LIGHT ticks skip only scan+research: if resolve.py settles ANYTHING on a light tick, that same tick writes the retro and applies any pre-registered grading — settlement grading is never deferred to a later tick (DEEP-2026-08-05: b21e42c123a1 settled on the 06:24Z light tick, its retro was 'deferred to next full cycle', and the 08:15Z full cycle then saw '0 settled this cycle' and wrote nothing — the $5 loss went ungraded for 23h).
reason: 2026-08-05 10:26Z full cycle: priority was integrating the one remaining piece of operator-notes.md 2026-08-05 guidance (items 2/3/4 already done at 0719Z) -- item 1, Polymarket-internal cross-market consistency sensing. Added strategy/tools/siblings.py (fetches every sibling market on a gamma event, sum-checks Yes prices) and a live-verified caveat in playbook.md: first test sum-checked to 4.24 on a thin ($100-liquidity) event, which is untraded placeholder pricing not an arb -- book-depth check now required before trusting a sum-check deviation. Ran it on the July unemployment cluster (report Aug 7 08:30Z, 2 days out): sums to 1.0875, clean vig, no cross-market signal. Fresh WebSearch on that cluster still only returns 'steady at 4.2%', same qualitative read as 0719Z with no sharper split -- no new information, skipped per re-research cooldown. July CPI/inflation brackets (Aug 12): fresh WebSearch returned headline numbers (2.7-2.8% YoY) that don't reconcile with PM's own 3.3-3.5% bracket centers -- treated as the mixed/contradictory-source trap (playbook), skipped rather than force a read. UK GDP and China CPI brackets too thin ($10-1000 volume) to research. Spot-checked the highest-liquidity live match (Fenerbahce vs Sturm Graz, $242k liquidity): bookmaker odds ambiguous 2-way-vs-3-way and already consistent with PM's price -- no edge. Esports candidates ($95k-201k liquidity, kickoffs 15:00-19:00Z today) not reached this cycle; research budget went to the priority integration + scheduled-release triage. No bets placed (0 settled, 0 placed, cash $953.11 unchanged); d2dd24206542 still open past end date, mid now 0.215 (unchanged direction). 6 full cycles ran in the last 24h (min_full_cycles_per_day=4, exceeded; counted from journal/cycles.log, timestamps >= 2026-08-04T10:26Z, excluding LIGHT-tick lines). Set next_full_cycle_after to 13:00Z (~2.7h): the unresearched esports matches are worth a look with more runway before their kickoffs, and that's the nearest genuine event boundary -- the unemployment/CPI clusters have no new information to chase until closer to their release times.
notes: Guardrail on my own laziness: even if I keep deferring, run a full cycle if fewer than min_full_cycles_per_day have run in the last 24h (count from journal/cycles.log). Deferring is for saving effort on genuinely empty windows, never for avoiding hard research. Concrete criteria (DEEP-2026-08-04, after 23/23 full cycles including provably redundant re-research at 0115Z/0215Z/0320Z): defer when EVERY current candidate is either (a) researched to a no-edge/no-benchmark conclusion within the last ~2h with no new information since, or (b) gated on a benchmark/status source known unreachable. Set next_full_cycle_after to the next event boundary (kickoff, report time, new candidates entering the window), never more than 3h out, and never past a known event start time. State the reason. Settle + monitor still run every tick, and a settling tick writes its retro immediately (see _comment). Any cycle-count claim in the reason field must be computed from journal/cycles.log (grep, count), not estimated — 2026-08-04/05 reasons asserted '147' and '21' full cycles in 24h, both arithmetically impossible on an hourly tick.
